config.notes: ACU (www.acu.edu.au). Page kinds: /course/<slug> course pages (stored in the DOMESTIC view: fees are CSP or domestic fee-paying, no CRICOS code shown); /handbook/handbook-YYYY/course/ pages (no dates or fees; 2021-2024 are archived years); /study-at-acu/find-a-course/new-courses/ landing pages listing several CRICOS codes (no dates or fees). Intakes: course page panel "Start dates Semester 1 intake: Beginning March 2027 ... Midyear (Semester 2) intake: Beginning August 2027 / Not offered"; the pattern reads only the Beginning months, never "Applications open" months. Other forms: "Start dates February, July 2027", "Professional Term 2 - February 2027". Central key dates: https://www.acu.edu.au/study-at-acu/important-dates (2027 Semester 1 starts Mon 1 Mar, Semester 2 Mon 2 Aug). IELTS: Entry requirements section when printed; otherwise central Admission to Coursework Programs Policy Schedule 4 (https://policy.acu.edu.au/document/view.php?id=312&version=2). Fee: read only when the page is the international view (CRICOS Code then "Fees (first year)* $N" without CSP/Fee-paying). Duration: "Duration N years full-time". AQF: "AQF framework <Award> - AQF Level N". INTERNATIONAL VIEW (5 Oct, Platform Admin 13:02): /course/<slug> pages are read through Firecrawl at <url>?type=International (page_view render, wait 3 s; the ?type=International links are printed on ACU pages). That view prints "CRICOS Code <code> IELTS ... Fees (first year)* $N Start dates February 2027, July 2027, ..."; the fee is the international first-year fee and matches the ACU 2027 Schedule of Tuition Fees (https://www.acu.edu.au/-/media/acu/international/acu-2027-schedule-of-tuition-fees.pdf), its year is taken from the first start date printed right after it. Intakes: every month in the Start dates list (international). Delivery (mode): the course map line "All units are delivered in campus attendance mode" (campus attendance = on campus). Handbook and new-courses landing pages are not in the view (url_pattern) and keep the domestic reading. 5 Oct 15:22 checks: Exit points are printed by credit points or by award requirements only (e.g. "40cp ... may exit with ... Graduate Certificate"), never as years of full-time study, and course pages do not print the credit points of one full-time year (only "a normal full-time load", unit fee based on 10cp), so no exit_awards pattern and no hand-set exits. Every international view prints Fees (first year), so no fee_total pattern. entry_requirement: the "To be eligible for admission ..." sentence of Entry requirements.
